To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the behavior of subjects and objects can be modeled by metrics, and statistical models; (2) the behavior of a subject with respect to an object can be represented as a profile; (3) profiles can be acquired from audit records; (4) profiles can be updated as more data is collected; (5) profiles can be used to detect anomalous behavior; and (6) the system is independent of the application environment, system architecture, system vulnerability, and type of intrusion

a model of a real-time intrusion detection expert system can be based on the hypothesis of detecting abnormal patterns of system use, that such a model can be implemented in an expert system shell, that such a shell can provide an efficient implementation of the model, and that a model can be constructed for a real-time intrusion detector that is independent of the system, application environment and type of intrusion.

(1) A model of a computer security expert system for detecting intrusions into a computer system can be developed by combining knowledge about computer security with knowledge about statistical analysis of audit data; (2) A model of such a system must include profiles for representing subject-object usage in terms of metrics, statistical models, and rule-based knowledge; and (3) The model can be implemented using a rule-based system and a database of audit records.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a real time expert system for intrusion detection in computer systems.
the development of an expert system for intrusion detection in computer systems.
the development of a model of a general purpose expert system for detecting intrusions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model is capable of detecting a wide range of intrusions, including break-ins, penetrations, Trojan horse programs, and other types of abuse.
the model is a general purpose intrusion expert system capable of learning about the behavior of subjects, detecting anomalies in that behavior, and providing an explanation of the anomalies.
the intrusion detection model provides an expert system with a framework for acquiring and utilizing knowledge about the system, the subjects, and the intrusions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a model for a general purpose real time intrusion detection system.
a general purpose intrusion detector is possible and that the technology exists to build one.

we have developed the theoretical foundations for intrusion detection expert system technology and have demonstrated the feasibility and utility of the technology by developing and applying a prototype expert system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a general purpose intrusion detector can be designed that can be applied to a wide range of systems and applications, and that can detect a wide range of intrusions.
a model of a real-time intrusion detection expert system can be built using a set of rules that are based on statistical models of the system usage behavior of subjects.
a general purpose expert system for detecting security violations is feasible.
